policy: Union individual historical mainline and Lumi 3.0 moves, filtered to implemented moves. Remove unsupported direct assignments; preserve six custom species and authored Pixie Punch. Retain valid acquisition levels and machine/egg routes. Missing access uses Blackthorn. Custom evolution carryover is reported explicitly, never treated as official compatibility. User-approved restorations are recorded separately from historical source claims in tools/testdata/authored_move_restorations.json.
